people.name: Abijah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

translations.web: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
translations.bsb: Abijah went into battle with an army of 400,000 chosen men, while Jeroboam drew up in formation against him with 800,000 chosen and mighty men of valor.
translations.kjv: And Abijah set ➔ the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
